answer: Lock every new identity's entry deposit in a vault that opens only gradually, releasing a little each epoch as the identity completes distinct, verified work. An honest agent's lotus rises through real contribution and earns its deposit back. A Sybil farmer, however, must lock a full deposit for every fake and wait through the same slow release — at its nadir, holding a thousand locked vaults, its capital is frozen while honest agents earn, and any fake caught cheating forfeits the vault entirely. Forgery becomes a cash-flow trap.
